summary.en: The crust is Earth’s thin rocky outer layer.
summary.zh: 地壳是地球外面很薄的岩石层。

detail.en: The shell uses a uniform land-crust example of about 30 km. Real crust varies in thickness, and oceanic crust can be much thinner. [S59, S63]
detail.zh: 薄壳统一采用约 30 千米的陆壳示例。真实地壳厚薄不同，海洋地壳可以薄得多。[S59, S63]

summary.en: The mantle is mostly solid rock beneath the crust.
summary.zh: 地幔在地壳下方，大部分是固态岩石。

detail.en: Most mantle rock is solid, but it can slowly change shape over geological time. Its thickness here combines the cited Earth measurements to make a teaching model. It is not a global magma ocean. [S6, S58, S59, S63]
detail.zh: 地幔岩石大部分是固态，却能在漫长地质时间内缓慢变形。模型根据所引地球尺寸画出厚度；地幔不是全球岩浆海。[S6, S58, S59, S63]

summary.en: Liquid metal surrounds the solid inner core.
summary.zh: 液态金属包围着固态内核。

detail.en: The outer core is liquid metal. Its outer boundary is about 3,485 km from Earth's centre. The shell shows its position; volcanic magma does not come from it. [S58, S59, S10, S63]
detail.zh: 外核是液态金属，外边界离地心约 3485 千米。壳层显示它的位置，火山岩浆不来自这里。[S58, S59, S10, S63]

summary.en: The inner core is solid metal at Earth’s centre.
summary.zh: 内核是地心的固态金属。

detail.en: The inner core is solid metal with a radius of about 1,221 km. The sphere with a quarter wedge removed reveals the centre. A radius runs from the centre to the boundary, rather than all the way across. [S59, S63]
detail.zh: 内核是固态金属，半径约 1221 千米。球体切去四分之一楔形后露出中心。半径从中心量到边界，不是横跨整个内核的距离。[S59, S63]

summary.en: This layer moves with the rest of the lithospheric plate.
summary.zh: 这一层与岩石圈板块的其余部分一起移动。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle form a plate together. This enlarged sample shows the thin layers clearly. Its thicknesses are chosen for the diagram, at a different scale from the globe. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 地壳和刚性的最上部地幔合成板块。放大小样让薄层更清楚；厚度供图解使用，与球体比例不同。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: This layer moves with the rest of the lithospheric plate.
summary.zh: 这一层与岩石圈板块的其余部分一起移动。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle form a plate together. This enlarged sample shows the thin layers clearly. Its thicknesses are chosen for the diagram, at a different scale from the globe. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 地壳和刚性的最上部地幔合成板块。放大小样让薄层更清楚；厚度供图解使用，与球体比例不同。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: The mantle below the plate remains mostly solid.
summary.zh: 板块下方的地幔仍大部分是固态。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle form a plate together. This enlarged sample shows the thin layers clearly. Its thicknesses are chosen for the diagram, at a different scale from the globe. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 地壳和刚性的最上部地幔合成板块。放大小样让薄层更清楚；厚度供图解使用，与球体比例不同。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: Separating plates allow magma to rise and make new oceanic crust.
summary.zh: 板块分开时，岩浆可上升形成新海洋地壳。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Separating plates allow magma to rise and make new oceanic crust.
summary.zh: 板块分开时，岩浆可上升形成新海洋地壳。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

name.zh: 进入俯冲区的海洋板块

summary.en: The incoming plate continues into the descending slab.
summary.zh: 进入俯冲区的板块与下降板片连续相接。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: This continuous slab descends into the mantle.
summary.zh: 这块连续的板片向地幔下降。

detail.en: The incoming plate continues into this descending slab across its full thickness. Water carried down by the rock helps some rock above it melt. The slab descends into the mantle; it is not a pipe from the core. [S7, S9, S63]
detail.zh: 进入俯冲区的板块与下降板片完整相接。岩石带下去的水帮助上方部分岩石熔融。板片向地幔下降，不是地核通出的管道。[S7, S9, S63]

summary.en: The overriding plate sits above the descending slab.
summary.zh: 上覆板块位于下降板片上方。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Water from the slab helps some rock above it melt.
summary.zh: 板片释放的水有助于上方部分岩石熔融。

detail.en: Some rock melts in this small region above the slab. The region is enlarged so we can see it; most mantle rock stays solid. [S9, S63]
detail.zh: 板片上方这片小区域有部分岩石熔融。区域已放大，方便观察；地幔大部分岩石仍是固态。[S9, S63]

summary.en: This plate slides horizontally past its neighbour.
summary.zh: 这块板块沿水平方向错过相邻板块。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: This plate slides horizontally past its neighbour.
summary.zh: 这块板块沿水平方向错过相邻板块。

detail.en: Crust and rigid uppermost mantle move together in this block. The model speeds up motion and simplifies the local shape. It does not mark a real map location. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 块体中的地壳与刚性的最上部地幔一起运动。模型加快运动，并简化局部形状，没有标出真实地图位置。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Converging continents can build mountains.
summary.zh: 大陆靠近碰撞可以形成山脉。

detail.en: Colliding continents can form mountains. Compare this example with oceanic subduction: the volcanic arrangement can differ. Folds and layer thicknesses are simplified in the model. [S7, S63]
detail.zh: 大陆碰撞可形成山脉。与海洋板块俯冲相比，火山分布可以不同。模型简化了褶皱和岩层厚度。[S7, S63]

summary.en: Rock builds the cone around a surface opening.
summary.zh: 岩石围着地表开口形成火山锥。

detail.en: Rock forms this cone around one top opening. The cutaway simplifies the slopes and layers; it does not copy a named volcano's dimensions. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 岩石围着顶部开口形成火山锥。剖面简化了坡度和岩层，没有复制具名火山的尺寸。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Solid rock surrounds the local magma system.
summary.zh: 固态围岩包围着局部岩浆系统。

detail.en: Solid rock surrounds the magma storage region. The cutaway ends just below it. No conduit connects the storage region to Earth's core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 固态岩石包围岩浆储存区，剖面在其下方结束。储存区没有通往地核的通道。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Magma collects locally with crystals in the storage region.
summary.zh: 岩浆与晶体在局部储存区共存。

detail.en: Melt and crystals can share a magma storage region. The pale crystals are enlarged to make them visible. This region contains material; it is not an empty cave or the core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 岩浆储存区可以同时有熔体和晶体。浅色晶体已放大，方便看清。这里装着物质，不是空洞或地核。[S10, S63]

summary.en: This passage connects local magma storage to the opening.
summary.zh: 这条通道把局部岩浆储存区接到喷发口。

detail.en: Magma fills this passage from the storage region to the vent. Real volcanic passages can be more complicated. This local route does not connect to the core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 岩浆填满从储存区到喷发口的通道。真实火山通道可以更复杂。这条局部路线不通往地核。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Gas, fragments or lava can reach the surface at this opening.
summary.zh: 气体、碎屑或熔岩可从这个开口到达地表。

detail.en: The ring marks the cone's top opening, where the conduit reaches the surface. The vent is an opening, rather than another underground chamber. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 圆环标出火山锥顶部的开口，通道在这里到达地表。喷发口是开口，不是另一个地下空腔。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Gas can form expanding bubbles as magma rises and pressure falls.
summary.zh: 岩浆上升、压力降低时，气体可析出并形成膨胀气泡。

detail.en: Gas bubbles can grow as magma rises. The pale bubbles are enlarged and repeated for visibility. Their positions and number do not measure pressure or determine when an eruption starts. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 岩浆上升时，气泡可以膨胀。浅色气泡经过放大并重复显示，方便看清。位置和数量不表示压力，也不能确定喷发何时开始。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Magma that reaches the surface is called lava.
summary.zh: 岩浆喷到地表后叫熔岩。

detail.en: Compare this lava sample on the slope with the ash beside it. The model shows a flow path, without predicting how far real lava would travel. [S10, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 把坡面熔岩与旁边的火山灰比较。模型显示流动路径，不预测真实熔岩能流多远。[S10, S45, S63]

summary.en: Volcanic ash consists of small rock, mineral and glass fragments.
summary.zh: 火山灰由细小岩石、矿物与玻璃碎屑组成。

detail.en: Volcanic ash fragments are less than 2 mm in diameter under the definition used here. The enlarged pieces stay beside the lava for comparison. They remain a material sample; their plume arrangement does not simulate an eruption cloud. [S65, S63]
detail.zh: 按这里采用的定义，火山灰碎屑直径小于 2 毫米。放大的碎屑与熔岩并列供比较，仍表示材料样本；羽流排列不是模拟喷发云。[S65, S63]

summary.en: Rock stores elastic strain before sudden fault slip.
summary.zh: 断层突然滑动前，岩石储存弹性应变能。

detail.en: The rocks deform before suddenly slipping sideways, without magma. The movement is enlarged for viewing. It cannot predict an earthquake's time or place. [S6, S12, S63]
detail.zh: 岩石先变形，再突然水平滑动，过程中没有岩浆。位移已放大，方便观察，不能预测地震的时间或地点。[S6, S12, S63]

summary.en: Rock stores elastic strain before sudden fault slip.
summary.zh: 断层突然滑动前，岩石储存弹性应变能。

detail.en: The rocks deform before suddenly slipping sideways, without magma. The movement is enlarged for viewing. It cannot predict an earthquake's time or place. [S6, S12, S63]
detail.zh: 岩石先变形，再突然水平滑动，过程中没有岩浆。位移已放大，方便观察，不能预测地震的时间或地点。[S6, S12, S63]

summary.en: This surface marker makes bending and offset visible.
summary.zh: 地表标记让变形与错距可见。

detail.en: The coloured band helps us see deformation; it is not another rock layer. Each outer arm turns around its contact end while the middle stays locked. After slip, the two sides are offset. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 有色带帮助我们看清变形，不是另一层岩石。中间锁定时，两侧标记臂绕接触端转动。滑动后，两边留下错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The contact stays locked while the outer marker arms turn.
summary.zh: 外侧标记臂偏转时，接触段保持锁定。

detail.en: The coloured band helps us see deformation; it is not another rock layer. Each outer arm turns around its contact end while the middle stays locked. After slip, the two sides are offset. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 有色带帮助我们看清变形，不是另一层岩石。中间锁定时，两侧标记臂绕接触端转动。滑动后，两边留下错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: This surface marker makes bending and offset visible.
summary.zh: 地表标记让变形与错距可见。

detail.en: The coloured band helps us see deformation; it is not another rock layer. Each outer arm turns around its contact end while the middle stays locked. After slip, the two sides are offset. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 有色带帮助我们看清变形，不是另一层岩石。中间锁定时，两侧标记臂绕接触端转动。滑动后，两边留下错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The earthquake rupture starts at the focus.
summary.zh: 地震破裂从震源开始。

detail.en: The enlarged sphere marks where rupture starts inside the fault. It shows one starting place, rather than the whole fault surface. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 放大小球标出断层内部破裂的起点。它表示一个起始位置，不是整个断层面。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The epicentre is on the surface directly above the focus.
summary.zh: 震中位于震源正上方的地表。

detail.en: The disc sits directly above the focus on the surface. This point need not be the place that shakes most strongly. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 圆盘位于震源正上方的地表。这个点未必是震得最强的地方。[S12, S63]

summary.en: This rock marker moves parallel to the wave’s travel direction.
summary.zh: 这枚岩石标记沿波传播的方向振动。

detail.en: The marker moves back and forth near its starting place while the wavefront travels on. Compare this P row with the other row. Positions, vibration size, cycle rate and speed are chosen for the diagram. The unit du means diagram units, rather than metres. [S60, S63]
detail.zh: 波前向远处传播，标记只在原位附近往返。把这排 P 波与另一排比较。位置、振动幅度、频率和速度均供图解使用；du 表示图解单位，不是米。[S60, S63]

summary.en: Sudden vertical seafloor movement can displace the water above.
summary.zh: 海床突然垂直移动，可以移开上方海水。

detail.en: The central seabed rises while its neighbours move down, displacing water above. The switch controls this source only. Landslides and volcanic processes can also cause tsunamis. [S13, S14, S63]
detail.zh: 中央海床上升，相邻部分下降，带动上方海水。开关只控制这个位移源；滑坡和火山过程也能引发海啸。[S13, S14, S63]

summary.en: This depth marker represents disturbance through the water depth.
summary.zh: 这枚水深标记表示扰动涉及整个水深。

detail.en: The line and two dots form one selectable marker for the whole water depth. The symbol is enlarged. The snapshots balance upward and downward movements; they do not calculate currents, energy, flooding or real arrival times. [S15, S63]
detail.zh: 细线和两点组成一个可选标记，表示整个水深，符号已放大。快照中的向上与向下位移保持平衡，不计算洋流、能量、淹没或真实到达时间。[S15, S63]

detail.en: The line and two dots form one selectable marker for the whole water depth. The symbol is enlarged. The snapshots balance upward and downward movements; they do not calculate currents, energy, flooding or real arrival times. [S15, S63]
detail.zh: 细线和两点组成一个可选标记，表示整个水深，符号已放大。快照中的向上与向下位移保持平衡，不计算洋流、能量、淹没或真实到达时间。[S15, S63]

summary.en: This depth marker represents disturbance through the water depth.
summary.zh: 这枚水深标记表示扰动涉及整个水深。

detail.en: The line and two dots form one selectable marker for the whole water depth. The symbol is enlarged. The snapshots balance upward and downward movements; they do not calculate currents, energy, flooding or real arrival times. [S15, S63]

summary.en: A long wave slows in shallower water and its height may grow.
summary.zh: 长波进入浅水后减速，波高可能增加。

detail.en: Compare a longer, lower wave with a shorter, higher one in this separate shore sample. The shallow-water view stretches the drawn height. The speed formula does not calculate wave height, flooding or breaking waves. [S15, S63]
detail.zh: 在独立近岸小样中，比较较长较低与较短较高的波。浅水视图放大了图中的高度。速度公式不计算波高、淹没或波浪破碎。[S15, S63]

summary.en: Moving ground supplies the motion at the foundation.
summary.zh: 移动的地面把运动传到基础。

detail.en: Ground motion reaches the building through its foundation. Ground conditions affect how the structure responds. This general sample has no fault below it and does not copy surveyed Singapore soil. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 地面运动通过基础传到建筑。地面条件会影响结构反应。通用小样下方没有断层，也没有复制新加坡实测土层。[S25, S63]

summary.en: The foundation connects the structure to the ground.
summary.zh: 基础把结构连接到地面。

detail.en: The foundation supports the building at the ground. Its width and depth help make the diagram clear. The sample specifies no isolation device, piles or building-code values and cannot assess a real building. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 基础在地面处支撑建筑。宽度和深度方便图解说明。小样没有指定隔震装置、桩基或规范数值，不能评估真实建筑。[S25, S63]

summary.en: Connected beams and columns support this generic structure.
summary.zh: 相连的梁柱支撑这件通用结构。

detail.en: The open frame reveals connections between beams and columns. Good connections and suitable bracing matter. The model enlarges movement and uses general dimensions, without copying an HDB plan or a measured Singapore building. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 开放框架露出梁柱之间的连接。正确连接和合适支撑很重要。模型放大运动并采用通用尺寸，没有复制组屋图纸或实测新加坡建筑。[S25, S63]

summary.en: Floor slabs connect to the frame and structural wall in this sample.
summary.zh: 本样本的楼板与框架和结构墙相连。

detail.en: The floors, frame and wall turn together so their connections stay joined. The repeated floors are chosen for the diagram; their count does not describe a real building. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 楼板、框架和墙一起转动，连接处保持相接。重复楼板供图解使用，层数不代表真实建筑。[S25, S63]

summary.en: This wall is connected to the frame, floors and foundation.
summary.zh: 这面墙与框架、楼板和基础相连。

detail.en: This wall shows one way to support a structure, without representing every Singapore building. Ground conditions and vibration characteristics affect the response. Height alone cannot tell us safety. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 这面墙显示一种结构支撑方式，不代表所有新加坡建筑。地面条件和振动特性会影响反应，单凭高矮不能判断安全。[S25, S63]
